label: Geb system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a Geb locus represented by GebA1 or GebA2 profiles that can protect bacteria from bacteriophage infection.
observations: Geb branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual GebA genes, GebA proteins, DefenseFinder HMM profiles, predicted source-database rows naming one Geb locus, unresolved Geb trigger or effector activities, and other phage defense systems.
